whenToUse: A district or municipal office where residents come to complete tasks and read announcements.
Public-sector sites that must ship an accessibility toolbar, statement and services A–Z.
avoidWhen: Non-profits fundraising from donors — use site-nonprofit-01.
University or company departments — use site-department-01.
a11y: The toolbar re-tunes text size, contrast and link underlines through tokens; system fonts and AAA text contrast are the baseline.
Status messages use role="status"; keep announcements dated in text, not only colour.
